description: Place the order from the current cart. Call review_order first so the customer can confirm the total. Set confirm:true to actually place the order — without it, this returns a preview only. Requires sign-in and a non-empty cart.

addressId.description: Address ID to deliver to. Defaults to your first saved address.

confirm.description: Must be true to place the order. If false, returns a preview (same as review_order).

confirmActiveOrder.description: Set true to place even though you have an active order — only after the user acknowledges.

addresses.description: Addresses eligible for this merchant's city.
